Budget: 10 uA ref, 60 uA tail, 300 uA output, about 0.75 mW at 1.98 V. GBW = gm1/2πCc ≈ 30 MHz. gm7 ≈ 3 mS keeps p2 well above GBW, and Rz > 1/gm7 adds an LHP zero for PM ≥ 70°. Slew is ≥ 30 V/us. A large-area input pair limits flicker noise."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair efficiency
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (flicker + gain)
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.4, 1.0),        # PMOS mirror load and M7 L (same, for matched Vsg)
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror load / M7 gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "ktail": (6.0, 4.0, 10.0),       # tail = ktail * Iref
    "kout":  (30.0, 18.0, 45.0),     # I7 = kout * Iref
    "Cc":    (2.0e-12, 1.0e-12, 3.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.2, 3.5),        # Rz = rzk / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["ktail"] * iref
    i1 = itail / 2
    i7 = p["kout"] * iref
    gmid_n = 11.0                     # NMOS current sources, same gm/Id + L as the reference

    # Bias / current sources (all mirrored from the ibias diode)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mtail = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # Input pair (source near 0.3 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.6)
    # Second stage PMOS CS: same L and gm/Id as M3/M4 -> Vsg7 = Vsg4 (no systematic offset)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["rzk"] / gm7
    cc = p["Cc"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtail)
    # input stage: vinn -> diode side (x), vinp -> output side (y)  => non-inverting at vinp
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # output stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "y", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    a1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * cl + cc * cl))
    zden = cc * (rz - 1.0 / gm7)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e12
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    sr = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    power = 1.98 * (iref + itail + i7)
    swing = vdd - (m7.vdsat + 0.1) - (m8.vdsat + 0.1)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    noise_1k = noise_th * 2.5            # rough flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    settle = 0.6 / sr + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m1.gm / max(mtail.gds, 1e-12) * a1 / max(a1, 1))
    psrr_db = gain_db - 25

    return n, {
        "gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
        "swing": swing, "slew": sr, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise_1k,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
    }
```
